resources.title: Introduction to Algorithms (CLRS) — 4th Edition
resources.description: The classic algorithms textbook by Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest & Stein. Covers sorting, graphs, dynamic programming and more. Lightly highlighted, spine intact.
resources.author: Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest & Stein

resources.title: Operating System Concepts — Galvin (10th Ed)
resources.description: Dinosaur Book by Galvin, Gagne & Silberschatz. Covers processes, threads, memory management, file systems. Perfect for OS exams.
resources.author: Silberschatz, Galvin & Gagne

resources.title: Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
resources.description: Essential maths reference for all engineering branches. Covers calculus, differential equations, linear algebra, probability. No writing inside.
resources.author: B.S. Grewal

resources.title: Principles of Economics — Mankiw (8th Ed)
resources.description: Mankiw's classic economics textbook. Microeconomics, macroeconomics, supply-demand, fiscal & monetary policy. A few sticky notes inside.
resources.author: N. Gregory Mankiw

resources.title: University Physics — Young & Freedman (14th Ed)
resources.description: Comprehensive physics for science & engineering students. Mechanics, thermodynamics, EM waves, optics, modern physics. Includes practice problems.
resources.author: Young & Freedman

resources.title: Database System Concepts — Korth (7th Ed)
resources.description: Silberschatz, Korth & Sudarshan. Covers ER models, SQL, transactions, concurrency, NoSQL. Excellent condition, used for one semester.
resources.author: Silberschatz, Korth & Sudarshan

resources.title: Organic Chemistry — Morrison & Boyd
resources.description: Classic organic chemistry for undergrads. Mechanisms, reactions, spectroscopy. Some pencil marks on early chapters but otherwise clean.
resources.author: Morrison & Boyd

resources.title: The Lean Startup — Eric Ries
resources.description: Practical guide for entrepreneurs and product managers. Build-measure-learn cycles, validated learning and lean thinking. Great read for MBA students.
resources.author: Eric Ries

resources.title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach — Russell & Norvig
resources.description: AIMA 4th edition. Search, logic, planning, ML, perception, robotics. The definitive AI textbook. Minimal highlights.
resources.author: Russell & Norvig

resources.title: Signals and Systems — Oppenheim & Willsky
resources.description: Continuous and discrete time signals, Fourier, Laplace and Z-transforms. Perfect for ECE 3rd sem. A few solved problems marked.
resources.author: Oppenheim & Willsky

resources.title: Atomic Habits — James Clear
resources.description: Life-changing book on building good habits. Great for any student. Very clean, read once.
resources.author: James Clear

resources.title: Design Patterns — Gang of Four
resources.description: Creational, structural and behavioural design patterns with C++ and Smalltalk examples. A must-have for software engineers.
resources.author: Gamma, Helm, Johnson & Vlissides
